name: factstore-ecom-index
doc: Identifiers and join keys for the records an online brand's systems own (Shopify, Amazon, the 3PL and QuickBooks), which the catalogue indexes.

attributes.doc: Shopify's name for an order, as customers and the 3PL see it, e.g. #18301.
Shopify's ID for a customer account.
Shopify's ID for one line of an order.
Amazon's ID for an order, e.g. 113-1234567-1234567.
One item line of an Amazon order, as order ID / seller SKU.
Amazon's ID for an inbound shipment of our stock to FBA, e.g. FBA19VV1M1CX.
One SKU in an FBA inbound shipment, as shipment ID / seller SKU.
The 3PL's receipt number for goods it booked in.
One item on a 3PL receipt, as receipt number / item code.
One item the 3PL shipped out against a Shopify order or an FBA inbound shipment, as the order reference / item code, e.g. #18301/ACMH-10021.
QuickBooks's name for a vendor, unique within a QuickBooks company, on the supplier, forwarder or broker it names.
Customer account that placed an order.
SKU on a sales, receipt, outbound or transfer line. A marketplace's line names a listing instead (line/listing).
Marketplace listing a line names: the seller SKU on an Amazon order line or an FBA inbound line. The line's SKU is the listing's.
Purchase order whose goods a warehouse receipt booked in; several when one receipt covers several POs.
